issues.issue: Whether the Appellant's exit from China supports a negative credibility inference
issues.applicant_position: RPD wrongly drew a negative inference from his exit; the smuggler assured him no warrant had been issued.
issues.result_quote: After my own assessment, I find that no negative inference should be drawn from the Appellant's exit from China.

issues.issue: Whether the Appellant is a genuine Christian
issues.applicant_position: RPD erred; his testimony on faith was accurate and consistent, and he is a genuine Christian.
issues.result_quote: I found that his testimony regarding his faith was persuasive and as such I find, on a balance of probabilities, that he is a genuine Christian.

issues.issue: Whether there is a serious possibility of persecution for an unregistered Protestant in China
issues.applicant_position: He fears persecution in China for attending an unregistered house church; the revised regulations make this risk serious.
issues.result_quote: I find that given all of the above information that the Appellant would not be able to practice his Christian faith freely

issues.issue: Whether state protection or an internal flight alternative is available
issues.applicant_position: The state is the agent of persecution, so no state protection or internal flight alternative exists.
issues.result_quote: In this case I find that there is no state protection nor is there a viable internal flight alternative
